topic: Robin walked through Blueno's door on purpose because of the Buster Call that erased her homeland
title: Robin Walked Into That Cage On Purpose
description: Nico Robin didn't simply get dragged away at Enies Lobby. Blueno offered her a door, and the Buster Call that erased her homeland when she was eight is why she took it. Here's my theory on why that choice matters.
comment: Was Robin forced through Blueno's door, or did she choose it to protect her crew? Pick one.

lines.text: Nico Robin walked into CP9's door on purpose.

shot.fallback: woman stepping through a train door

lines.text: Sanji and Sogeking were begging her to come back.

shot.fallback: two pirates pleading with a woman

lines.text: Blueno didn't drag her. He reminded her of Ohara.

shot.fallback: agent speaking to a frightened woman

lines.text: The Buster Call erased her homeland when she was eight.
Twenty years later, CP9 agents from that invasion stood right in front of her.

shot.fallback: shadowy agents in suits on a ship

lines.text: That's the part most fans skip over.
Fear is a chain, but it's also a choice she made.
Her crew didn't lose her to a cage.

shot.fallback: pirate crew watching a train leave

lines.text: They lost her to a memory she couldn't outrun.

shot.fallback: young girl on a burning shore

lines.text: Which is why Nico Robin walked through that door without ever being truly caught.

self_check.hook: line 1 names Robin and claims she walked through the door on purpose
self_check.loop: last line leads back into line 1 about walking through the door
